ai.imageAlt: Business leader reviewing an AI-enabled workflow
ai.heading: AI automation that fits
ai.lead: AI should not be added just because it is trending. It should solve a clear business problem.
ai.body: Barakode helps companies identify where AI can reduce manual work, improve response times, organize knowledge, support customers, process documents, and connect business tools. We design AI workflows with human review, data privacy, and practical implementation in mind.

cases.title: AI customer support assistant
cases.body: Answers routine questions from your own knowledge base, drafts replies for review, and hands anything sensitive straight to a person.

cases.title: RAG chatbot
cases.body: Answers from selected business knowledge such as FAQs, product docs, manuals, policies, and SOPs instead of guessing from general model knowledge.

cases.title: Document processing
cases.body: Extracts structured fields from invoices, contracts, forms, reports and résumés, then routes the exceptions to a human.

cases.title: CRM automation
cases.body: Scores leads, updates records, drafts follow-ups, summarises calls, and moves deals through the pipeline without manual data entry.

cases.title: Reporting automation
cases.body: Collects the data, summarises what changed, updates the dashboard, and raises an alert when something needs attention.

cases.title: Internal AI agents
cases.body: Task-scoped assistants that follow defined rules, use the tools they are given, and stop for human sign-off where it matters.

cases.title: SaaS AI features
cases.body: AI capability built into your existing product, including search, summarisation, drafting, and classification, with admin controls and audit logs.

ai.moreBody: Full workflows, the human review gates, and what we will not automate.

process.heading: A clear process from first idea to
process.body: Good software does not happen by accident. We follow a structured product engineering process that helps reduce confusion, manage scope, improve communication, and deliver software that is easier to build, test, launch, and maintain.

steps.title: Discovery & Requirement Mapping
steps.short: Understand the business, the users, and the constraints before anything is scoped.

steps.title: UI Design & Prototyping
steps.short: Validate the product on screen before it is built.

steps.title: Development Sprint Planning
steps.short: Break the build into milestones with dates attached.

steps.title: Full-Stack Development
steps.short: Frontend, backend, database, APIs, admin, built in reviewable increments.

steps.title: AI / Automation Integration
steps.short: Where it earns its place: AI workflows, automation rules, integrations.

steps.title: QA, Testing & Deployment
steps.short: Functionality, responsiveness, edge cases, then a controlled launch.

steps.title: Maintenance, Scaling & Support
steps.short: The product keeps working, and keeps improving, after launch.

values.title: Full-stack delivery
values.body: We support the full product lifecycle from planning and design to backend, frontend, mobile, cloud, QA, and maintenance.

values.title: Clear communication
values.body: You get structured updates, transparent scope, and a team that understands business priorities.

values.title: Built for scale

items.q: What type of projects does Barakode work on?
items.a: Barakode works on MVPs, SaaS platforms, web apps, mobile apps, internal business systems, AI automation workflows, dashboards, admin panels, and product maintenance.
Yes. We help startup founders plan, design, build, and launch focused MVPs and SaaS products.

items.q: Can you help with an existing product?
items.a: Yes. We can review, improve, redesign, maintain, or extend existing software products depending on the current codebase and business goals.
Yes. We build practical AI workflows such as AI chatbots, RAG assistants, document processing, CRM automation, support automation, and reporting automation.
We work through structured updates, planned meetings, shared documentation, and clear delivery checkpoints.
Ownership terms should be agreed before the project starts. In most custom development projects, clients receive ownership based on the agreed contract.

items.q: How do pricing and timelines work?
items.a: Pricing and timelines depend on scope, features, integrations, platforms, and complexity. We provide a custom quote after understanding the project.
